7.8.5.2 LINTP_E_LINTPNCS_TIMEOUT_OCCURRED
[SWS_LinIf_00882] ⌈ Error Name: LINTP_E_LINTPNCS_TIMEOUT_OCCURRED Short Description: A N_Cs timeout is detected Long Description: LinIf (LinTp part) shall report a LINTP_E_LINTPNCS_TIMEOUT_OCCURRED Extended Production Error to DEM when a N_Cs timeout is detected. Fail N_Cs timer expired Detection Criteria: Pass LinTp_Init() function call Secondary Parameters: The condition under which the FAIL and/or PASS detection is active: None Time Required: Not applicable Monitor Frequency: on event
⌋()
